how: big warm smile, shouted to a whole crowd, a little laugh at the end
where: beat 2, over the needle drop and the dusk pad of the intro

how: excited, leaning in to him, rising at the end
where: beat 8, intro, as the first soft kicks come in

how: a count-in, each word short and separate with a clear little pause between words (I cut it into four words and put each on its beat), getting louder
where: beats 12, 13, 14, 15 (the take cut into its four words, each on its beat), into the first drop at beat 16

how: shouted, laughing, delighted: the crowd loved it, so she spins the record back
where: beat 22, right after the first drop; the record rewinds under her and the drop comes again at beat 24

how: big and heavy on 'stapp, stapp', playful, like stomping
where: beats 88 ("Stóru grasbítar!") and 92 ("Stapp, stapp!"), over the grazers' half-time stomp

how: drawn out, slow and teasing, a giggle in it, quieter
where: beats 104, 107, 110 (one word group each), while the record plays at half speed (the turtles are slow)

how: one sudden happy shout
where: beat 112, the record jumps back to full speed and the turtles' groove drops

how: shouted, laughing
where: beat 128, as the frogs' part drops

how: quick and bright, 'hratt, hratt' fast
where: beats 144 ("Litlu eðlur!") and 147 ("Hratt, hratt!"), as the small lizards' part drops

how: a gleeful shout, she loves speed
where: beat 151, then the record plays at double speed for two bars

how: lifting, bright, looking up into the sky
where: beat 160, as the small flyers' part drops

how: surprised and happy, welcoming new guests
where: beat 168, as the dragonflies' buzz-scratches join the flyers

how: proud, cheeky, laughing, rubbing her wings: the DJ's own solo starts
where: beat 176, start of her turntable solo

how: one short punchy shout, very clear 'Dj' at the start; I scratch, cut and stutter this one take, so plain and dry is best
where: beat 180 as itself with an echo throw, then scratched on the decks at 6-8, 181-184, 191-192, 205.75 and 338-340

how: cheerful, inviting new guests to play
where: beat 184, the beetles click along with her scratches

how: call to him, a big 'JÁ' at the end; then a gap for him to answer
where: beat 192; the music leaves a gap at 196-198 for Egill, then all the animals answer at 198

how: laughing, encouraging, cupping a wing to her ear
where: beat 200; gap at 202-204 for Egill, then a bigger answer at 204-206

how: warmer and gentler, kind, as the music slows to a stop for her
where: beats 206 ("Slóeðla!") and 208 ("Spilaðu fyrir okkur!"); the record brakes to a stop at 210-212 and her horn begins at 212

how: rousing, joyful, the whole crowd raises its wings
where: beat 244, start of the rise

how: to Egill, excited, as on the flight up the waterfall
where: beat 260, the rise gets faster

how: big shout over the stuttering music, right before the drop
where: beat 273, over the stuttering record, the drop at 276

how: laughing, delighted, the big pull-up
where: beat 281; the record rewinds at 282 and the top drop comes again at 284

en: Yippee! The biggest party in the world!
how: wild with joy at the very top, laughing in the wind
where: beats 320 ("Jibbí!") and 322, in the last time everyone sings her tune

how: warm and happy, a bit out of breath, a smile
where: beat 354, over the held last chord, before the last hit at 360
